title: 第15章 蛮荒之地第16章 血条都快戳到脸上了
content_zh:
“在蛮荒界的其他收获，皆归自身。”
此言一出，台下数千弟子呼吸都为之一窒。这意味着，能赚取多少，全凭个人本事，宗门分文不取。
即便早有耳闻，得到证实后，楚墨心中仍感难以置信。
一个连身份令牌都要收费的宗门，竟会放弃榨取弟子异界所得？
蛮荒界的特产如精品赤血矿、血缘果，在宗门内可是价值数百法钱！
不收个考核费、采集税之类的，简直不像是度厄宗的作风！
‘怪不得说异界征伐是大机缘。’楚墨眼中闪烁着蠢蠢欲动的光芒。
不是他贪财，而是法钱本身就是一种珍贵资源，由化神道君施展大神通炼制，可以辅助修炼。
其灵机之纯粹，甚至远超一般的天地灵炁。
果然，台下弟子群情激动，尤其那些身负巨债，情况危如累卵者。只要在蛮荒界中收获足够，一切都不是问题。
为首的筑基修士俯瞰气势高涨的人群，微微颔首，不再多言，与其余几位筑基上人一同施法。
广场中央空间剧烈扭曲，无数道银色符文徐徐旋转，一个容纳数人同行、散发着不稳定灵光的漩涡之门缓缓成形。
通道另一端，隐约传来古老、野蛮的气息，仿佛有巨兽在嘶吼，蛮荒之风在咆哮。
‘这是？’楚墨凝视漩涡，一道特殊的信息标识浮现。
【地图：残破的蛮荒界】
【建议玩家进入等级：1~15级】
“若遇筑基层次余孽，可凭身份令牌求援，宗门自会救援，但考核成绩作废。”为首筑基修士补充道，随即袖袍一挥，
“通道已开，考核开始。诸位，道运昌隆！”
话音刚落，早已忍耐不住的弟子们，立刻各施手段，争先恐后涌入那漩涡之门中，唯恐慢人一步，机缘尽失。
赢乐激动的望向楚墨：“楚兄，我们也赶快进去。”他还没有放弃拉对方入伙的打算。

楚墨却不动声色，略带歉意回道：“赢兄先行，我随后便到。”
赢乐深深看他一眼，道声“再会”，拉着楚瑶与张猛挤入通道之中。
待到人群稍稀，楚墨才混在末尾踏入漩涡。
高台上，一名筑基修士朝身旁同门打趣道：“陈师兄，你认为此番会有几人过关？”
被称呼为陈师兄的修士，淡然一笑，“十之一二吧。毕竟如今的蛮荒界，对他们说还是挺危险的。你觉得呢，青松？”
青松望着漩涡通道，沉吟片刻：“最多......一百人。”
怎么说，蛮荒界曾经也是能容纳元婴真君的大世界。
......
通道内天旋地转，像是一个滚筒洗衣机，强烈的眩晕感让楚墨胃里翻江倒海。
所幸过程短暂，片刻后，双脚踏上实地。
落地的刹那，早已扣在掌心的【炎阳护身符】瞬间激发，赤红光幕护住周身，生肌丹也同时含在嘴中。
不等楚墨观察四周，剧烈的喘息声从身后传来，一道黑影带猛的撞向后背。
“咚！”
闷响声，那只不明生物被焰幕弹开，发出哀嚎。
楚墨回首，一头披覆厚甲的巨型野猪肚皮朝天，仰躺在大地上。只剩半截獠牙，断开之处漆黑一片，仿佛被大火烧过。
除此之外，还有三只体型稍小的野猪，正眼睛赤红，虎视眈眈望着自己。
content_en:
"Everything else gained in the wild world belongs to oneself."
As soon as these words came out, the breath of thousands of disciples in the audience was choked. This means that how much you can earn depends entirely on your own abilities, and the sect will not take any money from you.
Even though he had heard about it for a long time, Chu Mo still felt unbelievable after it was confirmed.
A sect that even charges for identity tokens would give up extracting the income from other worlds from its disciples?
The special products of the wild world, such as high-quality red blood ore and blood fruit, are worth hundreds of mana within the sect!
Not charging an assessment fee, collection tax, etc. is simply not the style of the Duer Sect!
‘No wonder it is said that the conquest of another world is a great opportunity. ’ Chu Mo’s eyes flashed with a light that was ready to move.
It's not that he is greedy for money, but the magic money itself is a precious resource. It can be refined by the great magical power of Huashen Taoist Lord and can assist in cultivation.
The purity of his spiritual energy is even far beyond the ordinary spiritual energy of heaven and earth.
Sure enough, the disciples in the audience were excited, especially those who were in huge debts and in critical condition. As long as you harvest enough in the wild world, nothing will be a problem.
The leader of the Foundation Establishment monks looked down at the high-energy crowd, nodded slightly, said no more, and cast spells together with the other Foundation Establishment masters.
The space in the center of the square was violently distorted, countless silver runes slowly rotated, and a whirlpool door that accommodated several people walking together and exuded unstable spiritual light slowly took shape.
At the other end of the passage, there was a faint ancient and savage atmosphere, as if a giant beast was roaring and the wild wind was roaring.
'This is? ’ Chu Mo stared at the vortex, and a special message mark appeared.
[Map: Broken Savage World]
[It is recommended that players enter the level: 1~15]
"If you encounter remnants of the Foundation Establishment level, you can ask for help with your identity token, and the sect will rescue you, but the assessment results will be invalid." The leading Foundation Establishment monk added, and then waved his sleeves.
"The passage has been opened and the assessment has begun. Everyone, may you have good luck!"
As soon as he finished speaking, the disciples, who had already lost their patience, immediately used various methods to rush into the vortex gate, fearing that they would be too late and lose their chance.
Ying Le looked at Chu Mo excitedly: "Brother Chu, let's go in quickly." He has not given up his plan to recruit the other party into the gang.
Chu Mo, however, remained calm and replied with a hint of apology: "Brother Ying, go first, I'll be there soon."
Ying Le looked at him deeply, said "Goodbye", and pulled Chu Yao and Zhang Meng into the passage.
When the crowd thinned out, Chu Mo entered the whirlpool at the end.
On the high platform, a foundation-building monk joked to his fellow disciples: "Senior Brother Chen, how many people do you think will pass this time?"
The monk who was called Senior Brother Chen smiled calmly and said, "Two out of ten. After all, today's wild world is still quite dangerous for them. What do you think, Qingsong?"
Qingsong looked at the whirlpool passage and pondered for a moment: "At most...one hundred people."
After all, the Wilderness World was once a big world that could accommodate the True Monarch Nascent Soul.
...
The world in the passage was spinning like a drum washing machine, and the strong dizziness made Chu Mo's stomach churn.
Fortunately, the process was short, and after a while, my feet hit the ground.
The moment he landed on the ground, the [Fire Sun Amulet] that had been clasped in his palm was instantly activated, a red light curtain protected his whole body, and the Myogenic Pill was also held in his mouth.
Before Chu Mo could observe his surroundings, violent breathing came from behind, and a black shadow belt slammed into his back.
"Boom!"
With a muffled sound, the unknown creature was bounced away by the flame screen and howled.
Chu Mo looked back and saw a giant wild boar covered in thick armor lying on its back on the ground with its belly turned to the sky. Only half of the fang was left, and the broken part was pitch black, as if it had been burned by fire.
In addition, there were three smaller wild boars with red eyes looking at him eagerly.
